## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include a regression test for behavior changes and real screenshots if the UI changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and requirements/warnings remain factual.
- [ ] Relevant build and tests pass; unverified checks are stated.
- [ ] No credentials, private files or personal data are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior.
